raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions has a filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` that silently drops valid POSTED transactions arriving late. From batch 3 onward the source delivers transactions about 3 days after txn_ts, so roughly 20-25% of each batch is lost. txn_id is unique, so there are no duplicates to guard against, and the filter has no documented business purpose.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
